entities.name: TikTok
entities.description: Advertiser partner for whom this document outlines advertising opportunities across Genuin's network of premium brands.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: SDK embedded in each in-network publisher's app or web property that renders the Genuin-powered video feed; available as JavaScript Web SDK or native iOS/Android Mobile SDK.

entities.name: Genuin Video Player
entities.description: Native ad rendering component used to render Genuin-served sponsorship ads within the feed.

entities.name: Google IMA SDK
entities.description: Integrated within the Genuin SDK to render programmatic in-stream and in-feed video creatives natively in the feed or player.

entities.name: Brand Content Console
entities.description: Genuin's content console where advertisers like TikTok upload branded video content for Genuin to serve into in-network feed slots.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Genuin's highest-impact placement where an advertiser's brand videos take over the entire content feed on a selected in-network brand, giving 100% share of voice.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Branded video cards that appear naturally within the organic content feed at brand-configured ad-slot positions, with a subtle 'Sponsored' label.

entities.name: Programmatic Audience Extension
entities.description: Allows advertisers to extend programmatic campaigns to Genuin's programmatically enabled in-network brands via direct ad server integration with top priority in the unified auction.

entities.name: In-Feed Video
entities.description: Programmatic video creatives appearing as native cards within the Genuin-powered content feed, rendered by the IMA SDK and played automatically as the user scrolls.

entities.name: In-Stream Video
entities.description: Linear video ads running around content on in-network brand properties, available as pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll with first-look priority.

entities.name: Pre-roll
entities.description: In-stream ad position that plays before video content starts.

entities.name: Mid-roll
entities.description: In-stream ad position that plays at the video mid-point.

entities.name: Post-roll
entities.description: In-stream ad position that plays after video content ends.

entities.name: Unified Auction
entities.description: Each in-network brand's ad server auction into which advertiser programmatic demand is integrated; top-priority demand is evaluated before all other programmatic sources.

entities.name: Bring Your Own Algorithm
entities.description: Capability for advertisers to connect their own targeting algorithm directly to the Genuin feed, making the targeting decision for every impression in real time for sponsored placements.

entities.name: Genuin Audience Targeting
entities.description: Genuin's default audience targeting capability available on selected in-network brands as an alternative to advertiser-controlled targeting.

entities.name: In-Network Brands
entities.description: The network of premium publisher brands that integrate Genuin's SDK and host advertising placements served by Genuin.

entities.name: TikTok DSP
entities.description: TikTok's demand-side platform that owns end-to-end targeting decisions and submits bids directly at the ad server level for Programmatic Audience Extension.
